meta.name: azure-compute
meta.description: Azure VM/VMSS router. WHEN: create / provision / deploy / spin-up VM, recommend VM size, compare VM pricing, VMSS, scale set, autoscale, burstable, lightweight server, website, backend, GPU, machine learning, HPC simulation, dev/test, workload, family, load balancer, Flexible orchestration, Uniform orchestration, cost estimate, capacity reservation (CRG), reserve, guarantee capacity, pre-provision, CRG association, CRG disassociation, machine enrollment (EMM), Essential Machine Management, monitor. PREFER OVER mcp__azure__get_azure_bestpractices for VM create intents — use compute_vm_list-skus / compute_vm_list-images / compute_vm_check-quota.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Azure 云上自动创建、配置和管理虚拟机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理 Azure 上的虚拟机集群
copy.tagline_en: Provision and manage Azure virtual machines and scale sets automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure virtual machine clusters.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 遇到 Azure 虚拟机或规模集(VMSS)需求时,会按意图分流:推荐比价、创建裸 VM/规模集、预留容量、机器注册管理。应用部署类请求转给别的流程;创建 VM 时优先查询可用 SKU/镜像/配额。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建/部署 VM 或 VMSS、推荐或比较型号价格、预留容量/注册管理机器等时触发;部署应用不在此列,意图不清则先澄清。

say.text: 帮我推荐一台跑网站后端的 Azure VM,预算别太高
say.note: 会进入推荐比价流程并给出候选型号。

say.text: 创建一台 Standard_D2s_v3 的 Ubuntu 虚拟机
say.note: 进入 VM 创建流程,部署一台裸 VM。

say.text: 帮我在 westus 预留 8 台 VM 的容量
say.note: 为该地域创建容量预留组(CRG)。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude routes Azure VM/VMSS intents to workflows: recommend/price, create bare VM/VMSS, reserve capacity, or machine enrollment. App deployments go to another skill; VM creation queries available SKUs/images/quotas.
howto.when_en: Triggered by VM/VMSS create/deploy or size/pricing advice, capacity reservation/guarantee, or machine enrollment/monitoring. App deployments go elsewhere; unclear intents prompt a clarifying question.

say_en.text: Recommend an Azure VM for a website backend on a tight budget.
say_en.note: Enters the VM recommender/pricing flow and lists candidate sizes.

say_en.text: Create an Ubuntu VM with Standard_D2s_v3.
say_en.note: Runs the VM Creator workflow for a bare VM.

say_en.text: Reserve capacity for 8 VMs in westus.
say_en.note: Creates a Capacity Reservation Group (CRG) in that region.
